title: Semiquincentennial Congressional Time Capsule Act
official_summary:
Semiquincentennial Congressional Time Capsule Act

This act requires the Architect of the Capitol to create a congressional time capsule in honor of the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence to be buried in the Capitol Visitor Center on or before July 4, 2026.

The time capsule shall contain a joint letter from congressional leadership (the Speaker and Minority Leader of the House of Representatives and the Majority and Minority Leaders of the Senate) and such other contents as they shall determine. 

The act directs the Architect of the Capitol to also install a plaque about the time capsule, subject to the approval of the Committee on House Administration of the House and the Committee on Rules and Administration of the Senate.

The time capsule shall be sealed until July 4, 2276. On that date, the Speaker of the House and the Senate Majority Leader shall present the time capsule to the 244th Congress.

summary.headline: Law directs the Architect of the Capitol to bury a congressional time capsule for the nation's 250th birthday, to be opened in 2276.
summary.what_it_does: The Architect of the Capitol must bury a time capsule with a plaque in the Capitol Visitor Center by July 4, 2026, holding a joint letter from the top House and Senate leaders and other items they choose, to stay sealed until July 4, 2276, when it will be given to the 244th Congress.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted February 18, 2026; the time capsule must be buried on or before July 4, 2026, and stays sealed until July 4, 2276.
